findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_restaurant_info, ask_restaurant, create_order, get_order_status, create_reservation, confirm_reservation, create_availability_alert, get_waitlist_status, join_waitlist · Private data: get_menu, get_menu_structured, ask_restaurant, quote_group, send_event_inquiry, prepare_order_link, create_availability_alert, get_waitlist_status, confirm_waitlist, get_waitlist_position, leave_waitlist · Public sink: search_restaurants, get_restaurant_info, ask_restaurant, send_event_inquiry, prepare_order_link, create_order, get_order_status, create_reservation, confirm_reservation, create_availability_alert, confirm_availability_alert, get_waitlist_status, join_waitlist, confirm_waitlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_restaurant_info, ask_restaurant, create_order, get_order_status, create_reservation, confirm_reservation, create_availability_alert, get_waitlist_status, join_waitlist · Private data: get_menu, get_menu_structured, ask_restaurant, quote_group, send_event_inquiry, prepare_order_link, create_availability_alert, get_waitlist_status, confirm_waitlist, get_waitlist_position, leave_waitlist · Public sink: search_restaurants, get_restaurant_info, ask_restaurant, send_event_inquiry, prepare_order_link, create_order, get_order_status, create_reservation, confirm_reservation, create_availability_alert, confirm_availability_alert, get_waitlist_status, join_waitlist, confirm_waitlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
